name: Proof-Carrying Adaptive State

selection.reason: High orthogonality to recent vision-lineage work while directly cross-connecting ClayCode type/effect validation, Unified Memory/UnifiedDB adaptive state, Harness replay and FRANK online learning.

research_question: Can every autonomously learned FRANK state transition be treated as a candidate artifact that must carry a small machine-checkable evidence/provenance/rollback certificate before atomic promotion?

mechanism_candidate.name: Adaptive State Promotion Certificate (ASPC)
mechanism_candidate.law: candidate adaptive state != promoted authoritative state until certificate verification passes
mechanism_candidate.promotion_semantics: build candidate -> evaluate in shadow -> verify conjunctive certificate -> atomic promote OR quarantine/reject -> retain last-known-good rollback target
mechanism_candidate.authority_boundary: A certificate proves compliance with declared promotion policy and evidence receipts; it does not prove that memory priors or labels are true sensor evidence.

hypotheses.claim: A conjunctive proof-carrying promotion gate can materially reduce unsafe adaptive-state promotions relative to a single aggregate utility score when regressions occur on retention, open-set behavior, resource limits or provenance/compatibility constraints.
hypotheses.falsifier: On representative FRANK update streams, a simpler scalar or existing gate matches or beats unsafe-promotion rate at equal useful-promotion recall and lower complexity.

hypotheses.claim: The certificate can be represented using ordinary ClayCode typed records/effects plus deterministic verifier logic without requiring a new language primitive.
hypotheses.falsifier: A concrete executable adaptive-state transition cannot preserve certificate, authority and rollback semantics through existing ClayCode IR/lowering without semantic escape hatches.

hypotheses.claim: Binding the certificate to UnifiedDB/Unified Memory state versions and evidence lineage can make autonomous learning crash-replayable and auditable across Retina, graph memory and tiny learned readouts.
hypotheses.falsifier: Crash/replay tests show accepted updates cannot be reconstructed or rollback targets become ambiguous despite certificate binding.

counterhypotheses.claim: A proof-carrying gate may overconstrain plasticity, rejecting too many beneficial updates and increasing latency/state growth without enough safety gain.
Machine-checkable proof receipts can create false assurance because they validate only the encoded policy and measurements, not the truth or independence of the underlying data.
Existing candidate-vs-current shadow evaluation plus rollback may already provide the same practical guarantees more simply.

external_evidence.use: Supports the producer-supplies-evidence / small verifier architectural pattern; does not validate the FRANK adaptation.

external_evidence.ref: Torres-Arias et al., in-toto, USENIX Security 2019
external_evidence.use: Supports cryptographically/provenance-bound verification across a multi-step artifact pipeline; used as provenance analogy, not direct learning evidence.

external_evidence.ref: Rolnick et al., Experience Replay for Continual Learning, arXiv:1811.11682
external_evidence.use: Supports replay as a practical mechanism for mitigating catastrophic forgetting; motivates retention receipts.

external_evidence.ref: Fulton & Platzer, Verifiably Safe Off-Model Reinforcement Learning, arXiv:1902.05632
external_evidence.use: Shows verification-preserving model-update framing is technically plausible in a learning setting; domain differs from FRANK.

synthetic_experiment.setup: Latent candidate task gain, retention delta, unknown-FPR delta, CPU cost and structural provenance/compatibility/rollback flags were sampled with noisy observed metrics. Unsafe means any true retention regression below -0.02, unknown-FPR increase above 0.01, CPU cost above 12 ms, or missing provenance/compatibility/rollback. Compared a weighted scalar promotion score with a conservative conjunctive certificate gate.
synthetic_experiment.interpretation: The stricter conjunctive gate drastically reduced unsafe promotions in this synthetic construction but rejected substantially more beneficial-safe candidates. The real research target is therefore the safety/plasticity Pareto frontier, not maximal rejection.
synthetic_experiment.limitations: Synthetic distributions and policy thresholds were chosen by this worker; result is mechanism stress-test evidence only and cannot be promoted as a FRANK performance claim.

cross_connections.delta: Attempt ASPC first as normal typed/canonical data plus verifier/effect policy. Do not redesign ClayCode semantics unless an executable counterexample proves current representation/lowering insufficient.

Persist candidate/promoted state identity, parent version, evidence/provenance refs, verifier policy version and last-known-good rollback pointer transactionally; test crash between certificate verification and promotion.
Add differential/replay cases for accepted, rejected, stale-version, poisoned-label and crash-mid-promotion adaptive updates; require H2 semantic parity for verifier receipts.
Apply first to Unified Memory <-> Retina online learning, where memory priors must never acquire sensor authority merely because an adaptive update is certified.

required_next_tests: PCAS-E1: replay actual H1 adaptive visual/memory update candidates under scalar-vs-certificate policies at matched useful-promotion recall
PCAS-E2: crash at every step between shadow evaluation, certificate write, state commit and index publication; verify exactly one authoritative version and deterministic rollback
PCAS-E3: inject BRONZE pseudo-label poisoning and stale feature-backbone versions; verifier must reject autonomous truth promotion
PCAS-E4: measure certificate bytes, verification latency and state-growth overhead on project hardware
PCAS-E5: ClayCode roundtrip/lowering differential test for certificate semantics before considering any language change

integration_result.material_delta: Introduce ASPC as a testable cross-branch promotion-contract candidate and explicit safety/plasticity Pareto experiment family.
integration_result.reason: Only synthetic test plus cross-domain primary evidence; no FRANK/H1 executable evidence yet.
